foreignObject.div: From the timeless, wind-swept stone heights of Third Mesa (Orayvi) where blue corn roots plunge deep into arid sand, to the majestic Saguaro cactus (Ha:ṣan) giants guarding sacred Baboquivari Peak beneath crystalline starry skies, health is living in sacred balance (Sumi’nangwa).
